This man (Japanese: '''青年''' ''young man'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN057|Memories of a Warming Kindness!]]''.

In the past, he and his {{p|Psyduck}} met [[Chrysa]], who fell in love with his Psyduck on a cold, snowy day. He and Psyduck began to build a snowman before Psyduck threw a snowball at Chrysa, leading to a snowball fight. After getting their photo taken, he and Psyduck left.

During the events of ''[[JN057|Memories of a Warming Kindness!]]'', Chrysa told [[Chloe]] of their history when she saw the photo whilst staying the night with her. Meanwhile, he encountered {{Ash}} and [[Goh]].

The next day, Chloe learned from Ash and Goh of who they met and went in search for him, believing Chrysa was in love with him. On bringing him and Psyduck to [[Cerise Laboratory]], he was reunited with Chrysa, only for her to show her affection for Psyduck.
